text:
emily: FYI a customer on Dedicated asked for repeatable actor IDs in audit ndjson exports so their compliance team can correlate who changed routing/policy over time. Right now it's just `actor.name`. Thoughts?

omar: Do they need raw ids or something privacy-preserving? We strip internal ids for some tenants.

emily: They explicitly asked for something linkable across exports without leaking internal DB ids.

jing: Suggestion: `actor_pseudonym` generated via tenant-specific HMAC-SHA256 over actor_id. That keeps it stable per-tenant and safe. Include `pseudonym_version` so we can rotate.

phil: If we add it, we must consider export size and perf. Large customers export millions of lines. Hashing latency could spike prepare time. Two options: precompute pseudonyms on actor create/update, or compute on export. Precompute saves CPU per-export but complicates rotation.

omar: We can store current pseudonym in actor index and update on rotation via batch job. For smaller tenants just compute at export time. We should make it configurable.

security-bot: Security note: HMAC with per-tenant key in KMS is preferred. Avoid deterministic salts like tenant_id only. Provide rotation strategy and document that old exports keep old pseudonym versions unless re-exported. Redact pseudonyms in public logs.

emily: UX: Console -> Compliance -> Export preferences -> toggle "Include stable actor pseudonyms" (tooltip: hashed id for e-discovery). Default OFF for free/trial; ON for enterprise. Toggle changes must themselves be audited.

jing: API shape (additive):

`{"event_id":"evt_2026","timestamp":"2026-03-01T15:10:00Z","actor":{"name":"ops-bot","pseudonym":"hmac-v1:abcd...","pseudonym_version":"v1"},"action":"routing.change","diff":"..."}`

jing: We'll emit an empty field when disabled to keep schema stable.

phil: Telemetry: we need metrics to monitor impact: `export.prepare_duration_ms`, `export.hashing_duration_ms`, `export.size_bytes`, `export.pseudonym_included{tenant}`, and a histogram of export.prepare_duration by tenant-tier. Also add a trace span `export.prepare` and tag `pseudonym_count`.

omar: Good call. Also add a small log when pseudonyms generated: `export:generated_pseudonym=***` where we redact middle. Ensure logs don't accidentally include secrets.

emily: Rollout plan suggestion: backend adds field but disabled by default. Console toggle behind feature flag. Canary to 5 enterprise tenants for 72h. Monitor `export.prepare_duration_ms` and support queue. If OK, 2-week ramp.

jing: For perf, I'll bench hashing cost with 10M events to estimate overhead. If >10% prepare time, we go precompute path for enterprise.

security-bot: Also confirm we don't leak pseudonym mapping in any other telemetry or crash report. Use KMS with key access controls. Provide customers with a note that pseudonyms are irreversible and depend on key; rotating key will change pseudonyms for new exports.

emily: Retroactive note: we cannot modify past exported files. Recommend customers re-run export for historical correlation or we offer a one-off paid rehash job. Document this clearly.

phil: Action items: jing - benchmark and RFC for precompute vs on-demand (3d). omar - KMS key design + rotation doc (2d). emily - UI copy + FF + audit toggle (5d). security-bot - formal review (48h). I'll draft the release checklist including telemetry alerts.

omar: I'll also add server-side guard so only tenant admins/legal seats can enable pseudonyms.

emily: Sounds good. jing, ping when you have bench numbers and PR ready.

jing: Will do, opening PR after bench.

phil: No blockers from infra side yet.

emily: Thanks all, adding RFC link when ready and notifying product for enterprise opt-ins.
